command:
set -euo pipefail
export KUBECONFIG=/tmp/managed-cluster-01.kubeconfig
kubectl get policyreport -n policy-test -o json | python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);r=[r for p in d["items"] if p.get("scope",{}).get("name")=="test-pod" for r in p.get("results",[])];print(r);assert any(x["result"]=="fail" for x in r)'
kubectl label pod test-pod -n policy-test app=test-pod
